title: Underfear
summary: Underfear is a mental spell used to increase the dark emotions of a Seeker, including rage and fear. Tantras uses this power to enable his trainee Seekers to bond with and summon darker-natured Titans.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
While recruiting acolytes for the Blood Spiral, [[Tantras]] used Underfear on a group of orphans including [[Harrison Fears]], [[Bruno]] and [[Dirk]], to help them bond with the Blood Spiral Titans [[Harlekin]] and [[Marauder]]. {{source|Den vs Harrison}}

full_text:
Underfear is a mental spell used to increase the dark emotions of a Seeker, including rage and fear. Tantras uses this power to enable his trainee Seekers to bond with and summon darker-natured Titans.

== History ==
While recruiting acolytes for the Blood Spiral, Tantras used Underfear on a group of orphans including Harrison Fears, Bruno and Dirk, to help them bond with the Blood Spiral Titans Harlekin and Marauder. [Den vs Harrison]
